programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Michael Green: What the Social Progress Index can reveal about your country
programme.desc: The term Gross Domestic Product is often talked about as if it were “handed down from god on tablets of stone.” But this concept was invented by an economist in the 1930s. We need a more effective measurement tool to match 21st century needs, says Michael Green: the Social Progress Index. With charm and wit, he shows how this tool measures societies across the three dimensions that actually matter. And reveals the dramatic reordering of nations that occurs when you use it.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Aomawa Shields: How we'll find life on other planets
programme.desc: Astronomer Aomawa Shields searches for clues that life might exist elsewhere in the universe by examining the atmospheres of distant exoplanets. When she isn't exploring the heavens, the classically trained actor (and TED Fellow) looks for ways to engage young women in the sciences using theater, writing and visual art. "Maybe one day they'll join the ranks of astronomers who are full of contradictions," she says, "and use their backgrounds to discover, once and for all, that we are truly not alone in the universe."TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: Civic Tech and the Sad Story of Freedom of Information in Hungary
programme.desc: «Átlátszó,» the word means «transparent» in Hungarian, and it is the name of Hungary's first independent investigative journalism website. A watchdog non-government organisation (NGO) which has experimented with introducing Civic Tech solutions in order to facilitate the work of its team, and also to provide citizens with empowering tools. Since Atlatszo.hu was launched in 2011, the Freedom of Information Act has received a lot of attention, and the legal way for questioning public bodies about spending, a «Freedom of Information request» has become the tool for many to reveal information about corruption.Marietta Le will showcase the use of the free software system Alaveteli, and the use of the Freedom of Information Act in Hungary. The law has been changed since 2011, and the latest news is about a threat that would make access to information much harder for Hungarian citizens. Meanwhile, Atlatszo.hu and many others are trying to implement new Civic Tech solutions in Hungary to help people exercise their democratic rights.Marietta Le is an FOI advocate at Atlatszo.hu Hungarian investigative journalism website. She also works with the K-Monitor anti-corruption NGO as a project coordinator to «Be Smart with Data», a program that facilitates NGOs in producing web apps and visualisations using open data. In 2015 the Hungarian Forbes magazine has featured her on their «30 under 30» list for starting «Jarokelo.hu», a street fixing website in Hungary.

programme.sub-title: Anand Varma: A thrilling look at the first 21 days of a bee’s life
programme.desc: We’ve heard that bees are disappearing. But what is making bee colonies so vulnerable? Photographer Anand Varma raised bees in his backyard — in front of a camera — to get an up close view. This project, for National Geographic, gives a lyrical glimpse into a bee hive — and reveals one of the biggest threats to its health, a mite that preys on baby bees in the first 21 days of life. With his incredible footage, set to music from Magik*Magik Orchestra, Varma shows the problem ... and what’s being done to solve it. (This talk was part of a session at TED2015 guest-curated by Pop-Up Magazine: popupmagazine.com or @popupmag on Twitter.)TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.desc: Kona til en mann Florida forsvinner, men et kornete videopptak kan avsløre den uhyggelige skjebnen hennes. Morderens telefoner fra fengselet kan ende med å skape flere dødsfall.

programme.title: Calls From The Inside
programme.desc: En manns første kone dør i det som tilsynelatende var et innbrudd. Flere år senere blir den andre kona drept. Politiet må avgjøre om det kun dreier seg om en grusom tilfeldighet.

programme.title: Killer Confessions: Case Files Of A Texas Ranger
programme.desc: En person skyter og dreper en mor før hun skal gifte seg. Politiet klarer ikke å løse saken, og tilkaller Texas Ranger Holland for å finne sannheten.

programme.desc: En mor kontakter Texas Ranger Jim Holland for å be om hjelp til å løse det gamle drapet på sønnen Joseph, som ble henrettet i skogen i Øst-Texas.

programme.desc: Familien Yates flytter til Spokane og oppdager at byen plages av en seriemorder som dreper unge kvinner. Familiens hjemmevideoer avslører en av USAs mest beryktede drapsmenn.

programme.title: Orangutangskolen
programme.desc: Begynn et spennende nytt semester på orangutangenes jungelskole på Borneo. Se ferskingen Bumi slite med konsentrasjonen, følg lettskremte Rumbas første steg mot uavhengighet og hei på stjerneeleven Valentino når han får en tøff start på høyskolen.

programme.title: Orangutangskolen
programme.desc: Følg den nye avgangseleven Beni, som får en spennende introduksjon til jungelhøyskolen sammen med tidligere klassekamerater Sura, Meryl og Wine. Møt nyankomne Molly, og bli med dr. Nadine når hun vurderer tregingen Bumi og villstyringen Monita.

programme.title: Orangutangskolen
programme.desc: Grøss når matvraket Beni får en dramatisk lærepenge fra den lokale dominante hannen, Petruk. Se den bortskjemte rikmannsungen Spanser, som før var et ulovlig kjæledyr, prøve å stille søtsuget før villstyringen Bumi drar på en vill kjøretur med Greta.

programme.title: Orangutangskolen
programme.desc: Skynd deg med å begrense malariasmitten som blir brakt inn av foreldreløse Cesia, og vurder så surrogatmor Sris plan om å hjelpe Bumi. Se orangutangmoren Daputs positive innvirkning på collegejentene, før du blir sjokkert av en tyv i matlageret.

programme.title: Orangutangskolen
programme.desc: Let etter den savnede, foreldreløse babyen Lahei, og se sjenerte Rumba bruke sin svake venstrehånd til redebygging. Se lille Bumi i timen, og finn ut om Beni og Valentino klarer å fullføre kurset og endelig bli fri.

programme.title: Orangutangskolen
programme.desc: Gratuler de nye avgangselevene på orangutangskolen, som ikke alle er ungdommer. Følg konvoien til frislipp-stedet, der teamet må ta et gripende farvel, og bli med på vill feiring når Molly og Bumi går opp et klassetrinn.

programme.title: Merkelige skapninger
programme.desc: Bli kjent med noen av verdens tøffeste insekter. Se kjempekakerlakker bygge opp immunsystemet for å sørge for at de lever lenge, den giftige ekspertisen til kjempetusenbein og usynlighetskappen til vandrende rosengrener.

programme.title: Vill vitenskap
programme.desc: Få et blikk på innsiden av livet til en av Afrikas mest ikoniske, men misforståtte megafaunaer: flodhesten. Opplev en slåsskamp på nært hold og se hvor livsfarlig bittet til en territoriell hann kan være, og se mirakelet med undervannsfødsler.

programme.title: Vill vitenskap
programme.desc: Forstå hvordan tilpasningsevner har hjulpet kaimanen, et villdyr som er like gammelt som dinosaurene, til å kunne håndtere dagens verden. Se sommerfugler forsyne seg av tårene deres, og la deg forbløffe av morsinstinktet i fellesbarnehagene.

programme.title: Månens ville side
programme.desc: Besøk en verden full av romanse og eventyr under stjernene. Forelsk deg i salviejerpens parringsdans, se et par polarrever gjenforenes, flyt blant ynglende fisk på et korallrev, og besøk parringsdammene til smed-trefroskene i måneskinnet.

programme.desc: Bli kjent flokken ved vannkanten: Hannene Tom Tom og Caller, åtte løvinne, 10 ungløver og Einstein, den voksne ungen som aldri dro hjemmefra. Se Einsteins stahet skape trøbbel når rivalene fra Outsiders-flokken gjør noe som avgjør hans skjebne.

programme.desc: Føl på presset når flokken prøver å jakte på tilstrekkelig mat mens tørkeforholdene presser dem (og byttet deres) farlig nær døden. Se Einstein tilpasse seg et enslig liv, og se skadene etter at den nybakte moren Kalwezi kjemper for ungenes liv.

programme.title: Flokkens regler

programme.desc: Ønsk overflodens sesong velkommen når flomvannet trekker seg tilbake og store flokker med byttedyr returnerer til bredden av Chobe. Se Keeza og ungen unnslippe mens Caller og Tom Tom sloss med fiendene, og bryt ut i jubel når Einstein finner en make.

programme.desc: Ringen er sluttet når tørketiden kommer og Waterfront-flokken har gode jaktforhold og fornyet tro på territoriet sitt. Feir suksessen til tidligere outsider Einstein, som får tingene på stell som ny konge av sin helt egen flokk.

programme.desc: Two men without whom the profession of conductor would not be what it is today. Two men who couldn't be more different from each other: Arturo Toscanini and Wilhelm Furtwängler. programme.title: ¡Repítelo! En busca de bucles
programme.desc: This one-hour documentary sets out in search of the phenomena of repetition in music history: from the Middle Ages to minimal music, from the motets of Josquin des Prés to Maurice Ravel's Bolero and pop music, from Handel to the hand-made loops of Mike Oldfield, from loop pioneer Terry Riley to live looper Konrad Küchenmeister, from George Antheil to Balinese gamelan music. “Play it again!” not only investigates the causes, but also the effects: What is repetition, what is variation and what is a loop? What is actually being repeated’? Does repetition have feel-good or rather anger potential? Music ethnologists, neuroscientists, composers and performers search for answers to these questions. Using selected works as a spotlight, the aggregate states of repetition are traced and, above all, listened to. Concert scenes alternate with dance scenes in which repetition sets the beat, supplemented by world music archive material.The eternal return of the same becomes a stylistic device in itself. The narrative strands are mostly cyclical: Short stories about repetitive routines become loops and playful cartoons tell humorous never-ending stories. Loop collages run through the film like a rondo, associatively taking into account non-musical manifestations of the endless loop.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The Boy with a Soap Bubble, Rembrandt
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: La Prison de la Santé, construite à Paris entre 1861 et 1867, est un ensemble architectural unique, homogène, imposant. À la pointe de la réflexion théorique sur l’enfermement, elle fut à son époque la "prison moderne" par excellence, la traduction en pierre des nouvelles obsessions pénitentiaires du XIXème siècle : la prison panoptique, la rationalisation et l’humanisation de la détention, la rédemption du détenu.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

These people all have the same passion for art and this series is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, (1525-1569) is one of the most renowned Flemish painters of the Renaissance. Although influenced by Italian art, his paintings maintained a typically Flemish tradition. A “peasant” painter, he depicted the lives of his country’s common folk as in the “Peasant Wedding”. In “Netherlandish Proverbs”, he wittily transcribes dozens of popular sayings. Admire also his incomplete “Tower of Babel”, a theme which Bruegel made into his own speciality.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: En 1997, la Fondation Guggenheim inaugure un nouveau musée construit par Franck O’ Gehry. Déjà connu pour ses formes étranges et déconstruites, il conçoit à Bilbao un bâtiment à l’échelle de ses ambitions : une sculpture monumentale, à l’apparence chaotique et abstraite.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Rembrandt at the National Gallery, London & Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Lucian Freud, l'un des peintres britanniques les plus célèbres de notre époque, est également l'un des rares artistes du XXe siècle à s'être représenté dans un autoportrait avec une telle constance. Ses autoportraits donnent un aperçu fascinant à la fois de sa personnalité et de son évolution en tant que peintre, depuis son premier portrait peint en 1939 jusqu'au dernier. Grâce à des entretiens fascinants avec d'anciens modèles, des amis et d'éminents experts, ce documentaire intensément captivant révèle l'œuvre d'un maître qui représente une étude captivante sur la dynamique du vieillissement et le processus d'autoreprésentation.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or rediscover the masterpieces by Gustave Moreau (1826-1898) on display at the Musée d'Orsay, the Gustave Moreau Museum in Paris...

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Michelangelo Merisi (1571-1610), born in Caravaggio, is known as a wicked artist who had to flee Rome in 1606 after killing a man. But Caravaggio is above all a painter who changed the face of painting at the very beginning of the 17th century. Notice his use of colour in the people emerging from a dark background, like his “Bacchus” or “David”. One of his masterpieces is the cycle of the “Calling of Saint Matthew” in the chapel of the church of St- Louis-of-the-French in Rome.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Les impressionnistes - et l'homme qui les a créés
programme.desc: Ce sont les artistes les plus populaires du monde. Les œuvres de Cézanne, Monet, Degas et leurs compatriotes représentent des richesses inestimables. Mais qui étaient-ils vraiment ? Comment et pourquoi ont-ils révolutionné l’histoire de l’art ? Qu’est-ce qui se cache derrière leur succès intemporel ? Pour répondre à ces questions, le documentaire a obtenu un accès unique à une grande exposition mettant l’accent sur le collectionneur d’art parisien du 19ème siècle, Paul Durand-Ruel, l’expert des Impressionnistes qui prit la décision courageuse d’exposer les Impressionnistes à New York en 1886 et ainsi introduire la société américaine à la peinture française moderne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Le rockeur progressif Rick Wakeman et son grand ami Ian Lavender, célèbre pour son rôle de Pike dans Dad’s Army, s’offrent une joyeuse virée sur les routes secondaires du Norfolk. Accompagnés des experts Raj Bisram et David Harper, ces deux chasseurs d’antiquités sillonnent le comté à la recherche de trésors à vendre aux enchères à Nottingham.Rick découvre d’anciens graffitis médiévaux cachés dans la cathédrale de Norwich, tandis qu’Ian fait un détour vers le nord du Norfolk pour admirer la plus grande collection de soldats miniatures au monde.Mais un sage vieil homme japonais aidera-t-il Ian à triompher aux enchères ?

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Situé en plein cœur de Paris, le musée du Louvre abrite une des collections d'art les plus impressionnantes à travers le monde, allant de l’Antiquité jusqu’à l’art moderne. Avec plus de 8 millions de visiteurs par an, le Louvre est le musée le plus visité du monde. A partir de cette collection, nous vous proposons de découvrir des œuvres d’art à ne pas manquer, comprenant « Mona Lisa » de Leonard De Vinci, « Les Noces de Cana » de Veronese, « La liberté guidant le peuple » de Delacroix et « La Grande Odalisque » de Ingres.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.sub-title: Johannes Vermeer - Girl with a Pearl Earring
programme.desc: Vermeer’s ‘Girl with the Pearl Earring’ was chosen by the public as the most beautiful painting in the Netherlands. It is also called the Mona Lisa of the low countries. The artwork has an incredibly beautiful light and almost inscrutable build-up of paint layers. What technique did Vermeer use to achieve this? The course of light and sharpness is unprecedented for its time. And is the pearl a pearl? The team will try to unravel these secrets by re-creating the painting with all the technology of today and knowledge of the past. Masterpiece faces many challenges in the search for Vermeer's secret.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Looting of the Gentili Di Giuseppe Collection
programme.desc: Federico Gentili di Giuseppe was a Jewish businessman of Italian origin with a passion for art. On his death in 1940, he bequeathed a collection of 150 paintings to his two children, Marcel and Adriana, who had become naturalised French citizens. In 1941, Maître Moulin auctioned off these paintings under questionable circumstances. This marked the beginning of a legal battle waged by the Gentili di Giuseppe heirs, which was to last nearly 50 years.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Alley of Poplars by Sisley, Nice Museum of Fine Arts
programme.desc: Sisley was a British Impressionist painter, closely associated with Renoir and Monet. On 20 June 1978, at 8.30 pm, a truck was stolen. Inside were around ten masterpieces worth 1.5 billion francs. The transport company responsible for returning the works following a loan had made no security arrangements. On 21 September 1998, ‘The Avenue of Poplars’ was stolen once again. This time, it was the curator of the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Nice, Jean Fornéris, who staged his own abduction! Finally, on Sunday 5 August 2007, five masked and armed men held up staff at the Nice museum to steal four paintings, including the Sisley. It was not until 2008, with the help of the FBI – which was also searching for works stolen from the Boston Museum – that the thieves were arrested.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous rencontrerons l’artiste Alain Godon. Des rivages de la France à la campagne anglaise, de parachutiste gérant de discothèque, Alain Godon a eu mille et une vies. Mais il est toujours resté peintre. C’est un peintre figuratif au coup de crayon naïf et gai, qui loin des modes, des courants et des engouements des musées, est plébiscité par de nombreux collectionneurs pour qui il travaille depuis son atelier à Waltham dans le Kent.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: An emblematic figure in Europe at the turn of the 18th century, this corporal who became Emperor of France unleashed the imagination of artists from whom he commissioned many works. Discover the victorious young “Bonaparte at the Pont d’Arcole” immortalised by the Antoine-Jean Gros in 1796. Observe also the portraits of all the guests present during the “Coronation of Napoleon” and his triumphant gesture as he crowned his wife Josephine in David’s masterpiece displayed in the Louvre Museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Jean Prouvé dreamed of creating homes as beautiful and rational as airplanes or automobiles. In 1953, at a time when he was going through the worst crisis of his life, he built his own house. Created in a hurry, out of bricks and mortar, it embodied his most innovative ideas. In a France where concrete was king, Prouvé was a man of metal, first folded sheet metal, then aluminum. From the 1930s onwards, he tried to rationalize the design of his buildings, dreaming of a housing industry that would build houses with the same precision with which cars and planes are built. This is what he calls "putting architecture back where it belongs". He is designing several models of low-cost, do-it-yourself kit homes, ready for mass production. Intelligent, functional and necessarily beautiful. The house he built for himself and his family in the heights of Nancy in the space of a few weeks in the summer of 1953, under dramatic circumstances, is a particularly moving embodiment of the designs and.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « Les Tournesols » sont parmi les tableaux de Van Gogh les plus célèbres. Le musée Van Gogh à Amsterdam a consacré une exposition à ces œuvres et « Exhibition on screen », qui a eu un accès exclusif à l’événement, nous guide à travers l’exposition pour enquêter sur les mystères qui entourent ces tableaux. Le film nous amènera également à Tokyo, Philadelphie, Londres et Munich pour suivre les 5 principales œuvres de l’exposition.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Lucas Cranach l’Ancien (v. 1472-1553) est un artiste majeur de la Renaissance germanique, actif à Wittenberg dans la première moitié du XVIe s. Peintre officiel de Frédéric le Sage, prince électeur de Saxe, il est proche du réformateur Martin Luther. Au-delà des thèmes bibliques, il s’intéresse particulièrement à la représentation du nu féminin, comme dans l’Adam et Eve de Besançon ou les fameuses Trois Grâces, récemment acquises par le musée du Louvre grâce à un appel aux dons.Bonne visite !

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, on relève le piquant avec les gastronomes gourmets Tony Singh et Cyrus Todiwala. Les chefs sont accompagnés de David Harper et Natasha Raskin.Partant de Dundee, ils descendent la côte est de l’Écosse jusqu’au village de Rosewell, dans le Midlothian, pour une vente aux enchères. Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The Boy with a Soap Bubble, Rembrandt
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Looting of the Gentili Di Giuseppe Collection
programme.desc: Federico Gentili di Giuseppe was a Jewish businessman of Italian origin with a passion for art. On his death in 1940, he bequeathed a collection of 150 paintings to his two children, Marcel and Adriana, who had become naturalised French citizens. In 1941, Maître Moulin auctioned off these paintings under questionable circumstances. This marked the beginning of a legal battle waged by the Gentili di Giuseppe heirs, which was to last nearly 50 years.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Rembrandt est largement considéré comme le plus grand peintre Néerlandais du 17ème siècle. Il est maître dans l’usage des lumières, particulièrement dans la technique du clair-obscur, c’est un dessinateur exceptionnellement talentueux. Le travail de Rembrandt a été considérablement influencé par les événements dramatique de sa vie ( La mort de sa femme, sa faillite financière, etc..). Dans cette exposition vous allez découvrir ses peintures les plus célèbres exposés au Louvre, comme « Bethsabée au bain tenant la lettre de David » ,mais également exposé à Mauritshuis avec « La Leçon d'anatomie du docteur Tulp » ou encore ces fameux autoportraits.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.sub-title: Fernand Khnopff - The master of the enigma
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Fernand Khnopff - The master of the enigma" at the Petit Palais in Paris. The work that introduces the visit of the exhibition dedicated to this amazing artist is called "silence". The artist represented landscapes of his childhood in the Ardennes in France. But he also painted portraits, paintings representing his mother as his painting entitled "Listening to Schumann".

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vincent Van Gogh : une nouvelle façon de voir
programme.desc: La vie de Vincent van Gogh reste entourée de mystère : folie, maladie, suicide, les ingrédients pour créer un mythe sont tous réunis. Bénéficiant d’un accès complet et sans précédent aux trésors du Van Gogh Museum d’Amsterdam, ce documentaire met en lumière à la fois l’un des artistes préférés du monde et la collection riche et unique du musée. Découvrez ces merveilleux chefs-d’œuvre sur grand écran pendant que quelques invités y compris les conservateurs de renommée mondiale et des historiens de l’art offrent leurs interprétations et des explications sur le travail de Van Gogh.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Lynne Faulds Wood and John Stapleton
programme.desc: Un Road Trip en couple de célébrités – les journalistes primés John Stapleton et Lynn Faulds Wood.Ils sont rejoints par Thomas Plant et Margie Cooper pour cette aventure. Avec 400 £ chacun, les équipes commencent à Wrightington, dans le Lancashire, et se dirigent vers Stockport pour une vente aux enchères.Lynn et Thomas se retrouvent littéralement jusqu'aux genoux dans des antiquités en cherchant de vieilles boîtes à biscuits, tandis que Margie tente de convaincre John que des lampes rares feront un joli profit.John apprend comment un Américain a révolutionné les transports publics britanniques, et Lynn découvre pourquoi on traite du lait de serpent à Liverpool.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Située sur la place Trafalgar Square à Londres, la Galerie Nationale est la maison d’une des plus grandes collections d’art Européennes. Celle-ci contient plus de 2000 peintures, allant du Moyen âge jusqu’au début des années 2000.Vous pourrez admirer des méthodes d’art et des œuvres d’artistes uniques au monde, comme la remarquable peinture flamande (Van Eyck, Vermeer), l’impressionnisme français (Monet, Cézanne) et surtout les maîtres anglais de l’art comme Hogart et Turner.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: Mondrian is one of the greatest innovators of Modern art. He started out as a landscape painter, but became world famous as a painter of abstract works. Mondrian tried to depict the world behind the visible world. He wanted to create "universal

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Originaire de la ville de Grasse dans le sud de la France, Jean-Honoré Fragonard est le peintre français le plus emblématique du 18ème siècle. Il a étudié à l’académie française à Rome mais à choisi de devenir libre dans son travail, préférant effectuer des commissions privées, dont certaines ont eu du succès comme « La chemise enlevée » exposé au Louvre. « Fanciful Figure » exposé au Louvre-Lens quant à elle démontre un style très moderne et original. L’un de ses chefs-d’oeuvre est sans aucun doute le tableau « Le Boulon », appartenant aujourd’hui à la collection du Louvre à Paris.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Art Poster in Paris Streets
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century, illustrated posters turned Paris into an open-air museum. From Chéret to Toulouse-Lautrec, artists and audiences met in the streets. This film explores this graphic revolution and its impact on society and modernity.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Construction of the cathedral began in 1247 and was only finished in 1880 after an interruption that lasted more than 300 years. Ribbed vaults and flying buttresses, the film explores the architectural vocabulary of the gothic style and its building methods. It reveals the most recent contribution of metal to architecture. It demonstrates how this cathedral that embodies German unity is at the same time archetypal of the Gothic style and of a 19th century building.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Le street Art s’est, depuis les années 1980, glissé dans les villes et ses artistes s’octroient une place grandissante dans l’espace urbain, mais aussi dans les collections d’art. Installé à Lille, Jef Aerosol fait partie des historiques du Street Art français avec option pochoir. Son genre, c’est le portrait, et il a longtemps puisé dans l’univers musical pour décliner sa passion. L’artiste est collectionné aujourd’hui par les plus grands amateurs de Street Art.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous irons à la rencontre de l’artiste Annette Messager. Ses créations bousculent la scène contemporaine depuis presque 50 ans. Elle est l’un des plus grands artistes français récompensée par un lion d’or à la Biennale de Venise en 2005. Elle emploi tissu, et objets du quotidien pour représenter l’intime. Mais elle reste aussi une artiste engagée. Installée dans la banlieue populaire de Paris, Annette Messager nous reçoit dans son atelier.

The vibe is fun, the pace is clear, and each move is broken down step by step. Perfect to start your day—or get moving anytime—alone or with the family.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, les plus gourmands ne devraient pas être déçus puisque c’est le chocolat qui est mis à l’honneur. Découvert par les mayas il y 2500 ans et plus largement ensuite par les Aztèques, le chocolat fait partie aujourd’hui des produits préférés des français. Et qu’on ne s’y trompe pas : au même titre que la cuisine a ses grands chef, le chocolat a aussi ses grands chocolatiers. Coté recettes, Julie fera découvrir un gâteau qu’on ne fait qu’à Saint Émilien et qui associe le chocolat au macaron, avant de rejoindre le Pays Basque pour un dessert qui ne manque pas de piment. Nous grimperons ensuite en montagne à la rencontre d’une cuisinière d’origine suisse qui fait des pains au chocolat à sa façon. Enfin, vous verrez que le chocolat nous réserve de nombreuses surprises : il possède de nombreuses vertus et s’utilise aussi pour le bien être.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tendre et savoureux, l’agneau tient une place prépondérante dans la cuisine festive mais aussi dans celle de tous les jours. Du Pays Basque au Cotentin en passant par Paris, Julie part donc sur les routes de France à la découverte des différentes races et types d'élevage existant à travers le pays. Il faut dire que la France a l'une des productions les plus variées au monde. Il existe plus d'une quarantaine de races répertoriées en 5 catégories : précoces, d’herbage, rustiques, mérinos et laitières. Mais plus qu’à la race, c’est à la façon dont ils sont alimentés qui intéresse les fins connaisseurs. Julie nous fait découvrir ses producteurs et cuisiniers de ce met raffiné !

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: Paracetamol, ibuprofen or aspirin… Painkillers are everywhere in our medicine cabinets. These treatments are so commonplace that we all too often forget the dangers they pose. First and foremost is paracetamol. Fourteen packets are sold every second in France. Often perceived as harmless, paracetamol is extremely toxic in the event of an overdose. For the 10 million French people who suffer from chronic pain, conventional painkillers are no longer sufficient, and it is often necessary to resort to painkillers derived from morphine and opium. The problem is that these medicines, such as Tramadol, can lead to serious addiction. Over the past ten years, the use of these medicines has risen sharply in France, causing concern amongst health authorities as these painkillers are wreaking havoc in the United States. Every day, 130 Americans die from an opioid-related overdose, which has become the leading cause of preventable death among people under the age of 50, far ahead of road traffic ac.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: In France, 30 per cent of adults and 50 per cent of older people are affected by high blood pressure. This excessively high blood pressure in the arteries can lead to strokes, heart attacks, kidney failure or dementia.The World Health Organisation ranks high blood pressure, known as the ‘silent killer’, as the second greatest health risk, just behind smoking. Being overweight, a lack of physical activity, smoking, a diet that is too high in salt and stress are all contributing factors.More often than not, high blood pressure presents no symptoms, making it difficult to detect. Whilst many patients are unaware that they have high blood pressure, conversely, others are wrongly classified as ‘sick’.This is because blood pressure fluctuates constantly and can lead to misdiagnosis. A bout of stress or physical exertion can cause blood pressure to rise. Another factor that can skew the reading is the ‘white coat’ effect, linked to the stress of the consultation. programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous emmène en Bretagne sud et plus précisément dans le quartier maritime du Guilvinec pour faire avec vous la route du poisson depuis les filets jusqu’à vos assiettes. Le Guilvinec a beau être le premier port de pêche artisanale français, tous les bords de mers de l’hexagone réservent de bons produits de saison. Julie remonte donc en voiture pour découvrir dans le sud un certain nombre de poissons d’élevage dans une ferme aquacole en Méditerranée, tout en cuisinant le bar à Noirmoutier, la lotte dans le Nord et même le cabillaud dans l’immense marché de Rungis. Julie a challengé le Chef Olivier Bellin installé à Plomodiern dans le Finistère, pour qu’il cuisine un poisson méconnu : la vieille.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana welcomes Héloïse Brion, creator of "Miss Maggie's Kitchen," for a unique culinary journey in Normandy. Héloïse, who has French-American roots, offers a clever blend of her American heritage and her life in Normandy. Together, they cook two original recipes: a stuffed squash with apples, inspired by local traditions, and a pecan pie, emblematic of American cuisine.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo offers a recipe for celeriac risotto with citrus powder. She will also prepare black rice with spring vegetables. A real treat for the taste buds!

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Haut-Rhin is the epitome of Alsatian charm. Riquewihr and its grands crus, Eguisheim and its half-timbered houses, Colmar and its Little Venice reveal a region where architecture, gastronomy and vineyards come together to offer an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: Charente-Maritime is a 500-kilometer coastline that conceals an unsuspected heritage. From La Rochelle and its fortified port to the Ile de Ré and its salt marshes, to Talmont-sur-Gironde, a medieval village perched on the estuary, this region reveals itself through the tides and encounters. An immersion between maritime traditions and historical relics.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Pays d'Auge is the beating heart of Normandy. Honfleur with its picturesque port, the Basilica of Lisieux, a major pilgrimage site, and the Haras du Pin, the cradle of horse breeding, illustrate the diversity of this land of traditions, where craftsmanship and gastronomy reign supreme.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: In north-west Corsica, Balagne, nicknamed “the garden of the island”, combines heritage and breathtaking scenery. This journey through unspoilt nature is shared with islanders proud of their land and traditions.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui c'est sur la route des champignons que Julie nous embarque. Rien de mieux pour occuper ses week-ends qu’une balade en forêt à la recherche de champignons comestibles. Certaines espèces, comme le cèpe ou la girolle, se conservent très bien au congélateur ou, pour les plus patients, en bocaux. Nous aurons également l'occasion de rencontrer deux Chefs passionnés par les champignons, devenus des spécialistes du sujet : Franck Quinton et Régis Marcon. Mais pour l’instant on prend la route, à la découverte de plats typiquement français avec d’étonnants champignons de Paris en Touraine, des morilles dans le Jura, des cèpes en Gironde, des russules charbonnières en Normandie et des coulemelles en Auvergne !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Afrikas dødeligste
programme.desc: De afrikanske savannene strekker seg over 50 % av kontinentet. Her finner vi et stort mangfold av dyr, også Afrikas dødeligste. Tilpasningsdyktige og mektige rovdyr som løver og hyener må takle både konkurrenter og velutviklede byttedyr. Vi ser alt fra lynraske geparder på jakt i Karoo til dødelig elvekrysning i Serengeti. Spesialistene på savannene kjemper en innbitt kamp for å overleve i det tøffe landskapet.

programme.title: Afrikas dødeligste
programme.desc: Sanddynene og ørkenene i Afrika er tøffe mot dyrene som lever der. Den enorme heten luker ut de svakeste, og bare de sterkeste overlever den karrige vinteren. Dyrene har lært seg å leve av landet, der de bruker kløkt, kraft og jaktegenskaper for å klare seg i det brutale landskapet.

programme.title: Afrikas dødeligste
programme.desc: Vannhullene er nødvendige for at mange arter skal overleve, og de tiltrekker seg store ansamlinger med dyr som kommer for å slukke tørsten. Men dette er ikke fredelige oaser. Der det er vann, finnes ofte Afrikas dødeligste i nærheten. Nilkrokodillene lurer under vannoverflaten, mens flodhestene støter sammen i voldsomme oppgjør om territorier. Ved kontinentets vannhull får vi se et fantastisk skue.

programme.title: Afrikas dødeligste
programme.desc: Bushveld-regionen i Sør-Afrika er hjemmet til flere av ikonene på det afrikanske kontinentet. I den urørte villmarken må dyrene kjempe hardt for å overleve. Området preges av årstidene, der noen av naturens mektigste dyr og største rivaler bruker rå styrke, hurtighet, bevegelighet og kløkt i den brutale kampen om dominans.

programme.title: Afrikas dødeligste

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Bli med til Australias unike øyer og møt noen av dyreungene som vokser opp der. Følg nyklekte grønne havskilpadder på den farefulle ferden fra reiret på stranden til havet, pelsselunger som lærer å svømme langs fjellkyster, og quokkaunger som tar sine første hopp ved moras side. På Tasmania kommer livlige tasmanske djevelunger ut av moras pung, klare til å utforske verden. Langt mot sør, på den subantarktiske Macquarieøya, møter dunete kongepingvinunger, sjøelefantunger og unge albatrosser utfordringene ved å vokse opp i et karrig og forblåst landskap. Gjennom fascinerende dyreatferd, overraskende fakta og nære familieøyeblikk følger vi den utrolige utviklingen fra sårbare nyfødte til unge dyr som er klare til å møte livet på egen hånd.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Bøflene forsvarer flokken sin mot løver. Elefantene viser hvor sterke de er når en stor okse utfordrer et kjøretøy fullt av mennesker. Et kappjordekorn ser døden i øynene, og hannløver angriper hyener. Rundt neste sving stjeler lekne dyreunger oppmerksomheten, mens en målbevisst krokodille jakter på elefanter natt og dag. Safariopplevelsene er intense, rå og ufiltrerte, og byr alltid på overraskelser!

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Når det gjelder overlevelse, bruker dyr i alle størrelser hemmelige våpen med dødelig presisjon. Fra bombarderbillenes kokende spray til sjøknelernes eksplosive klubbe og flygeagamernes skjulte vinger, ser vi nærmere på naturens mest fantastiske hemmelige våpen.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike

programme.desc: Traumer, dramatikk og en grisunge i fare. Grisungen Winston kommer til klinikken til dr. Pol i all hast etter at eierne hans ble bekymret over grisens plutselig dårlige helse. Dr. Emily er bekymret for at det er tetanus, noe som kan være dødelig for små dyr, så alle veterinærene må trå til for at Winston skal overleve. I mellomtiden er klinikken travel med oppblåste kalver, katter med mark og til og med en skadet emu.

programme.title: 10 dyr som kan drepe deg: Sjokkerende angrep
programme.desc: Det er mange dyr, fra dingoer til kuer, som kan være livsfarlige. Risikoen for å bli drept av et dyr er svært liten, men bare sånn i tilfelle.her er ti måter du kan dø på og hvordan du kan unngå det. Yukon-veterinæren Michelle Oakley og naturfotografen Filipe DeAndrade deler personlige historier og forteller om skapninger som kan ta livet av oss. Men vil dyrene egentlig det?

programme.title: 10 dyr som kan drepe deg: Sjokkerende angrep
programme.desc: Det er mange dyr, fra dingoer til kuer, som kan være livsfarlige. Risikoen for å bli drept av et dyr er svært liten, men bare sånn i tilfelle.her er ti måter du kan dø på og hvordan du kan unngå det. programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: For å overleve ville landskap, matmangel og farlige rovdyr, trenger skapninger mer enn rå styrke for å overleve dagen. Dyr med superkrefter som en sjette sans klarer å få overtaket på hurtige bytter, overleve værforholdene og finne mat på usannsynlige steder.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Kamuflasje, mimikk og sniking er verktøy som brukes av de smarteste dyrene på planeten. Disse dyrene er bemerkelsesverdige bedragerimestere, fra tigre som bruker sin oransje pels som jaktkamuflasje, og en edderkopp som later som den er en maur for å snike seg inn i kolonien, til en fugl som bruke falske nødskrik for å lure surikater til å gi opp byttet sitt.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Enten de skal unnslippe farlige rovdyr eller bekjempe tøffe rivaler, så er ikke alltid rå styrke nok til å lykkes. Vi møter noen av planetens mest unike dyr som tar i bruk utrolige superkrefter, som akrobatikk som trosser døden, hemmelige sanser og skjulte våpen, for å overleve.

programme.title: Afrikas elvegiganter
programme.desc: Afrikas kraftfulle elver huser et variert utvalg av beboere slik som elefanter og flodhester som spiser og drikker der krokodillene jakter og formerer seg. Vi avslører hvordan disse gigantiske dyrene ufrivillig deler vannet med andre, mindre skapninger slik som pinnsvin, kampørner og leoparder.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: For å overleve ville landskap, matmangel og farlige rovdyr, trenger skapninger mer enn rå styrke for å overleve dagen. Dyr med superkrefter som en sjette sans klarer å få overtaket på hurtige bytter, overleve værforholdene og finne mat på usannsynlige steder.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: I en øde del av Afrika er en familie med villhunder på rømmen. De er på desperat jakt etter et trygt sted til de seks ungene. Men fristedet er fullt av rivaler som står i veien for dem og rovdyr som vil ta ungene. Bare standhaftigheten til lederne, Teemana og Malao, kan redde dem.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: June må ta seg av den foreldreløse valpen Vince når han prøver å bli med i flokken hennes. I Highlands leter Scarletts uredde unger etter to grevlinger, og det får dødelige konsekvenser. I Flatlands håper Ruby at tøff kjærlighet kan hjelpe sønnen hennes Kip til å lære seg å spise selv før melken hennes går tom.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Gjennom årstidens skiftende sykluser åpenbarer Spanias nasjonalpark Sierra de Gredos seg som et av Europas mest bemerkelsesverdige naturlandskap. Fra eldgamle isbreer og dype fjellkløfter til toppen av Pico Almanzor, det høyeste fjellet i sentrale Spania, kan du bli kjent med et unikt og sårbart økosystem. Her hersker den iberiske steinbukken, en ikonisk art som er innbegrepet av disse fjellene. Ved siden av den lever kongeørner, fjellfugler og otere i et område preget av isolasjon og motstandskraft. Dette er et portrett av villmark og balanse, et vindu inn i et av Europas siste store villmarksområder.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: Præriehundene i New-Mexico stilles overfor mange farer. På slettene må June gjøre noe med invasjonen av lopper.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Gjennom årstidens skiftende sykluser åpenbarer Spanias nasjonalpark Sierra de Gredos seg som et av Europas mest bemerkelsesverdige naturlandskap. programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Sommeren byr på overflod, men i kappløpet om å utnytte den korte varme årstiden følger også konkurranse, aggresjon og fare. Høyt oppe på fjellengene kjemper alpemurmeldyrene om de beste hiene der de kan oppfostre ungene sine. Men klarer de å unnslippe sultne bjørner? Bjørnungene i Karpatene vokser raskt, men trues av voksne hannbjørner som vil kvitte seg med rivalenes avkom. Klarer binnene å beskytte dem med sine smarte strategier? Flokker av europeisk bison dundrer gjennom de gamle skogene på jakt etter mat og vann. De er et av de fremste eksemplene på vellykket reintroduksjon, fordi tråkkene deres skaper liv i hele skogen og gir gode vilkår for milliarder av insekter. Insektene søker videre til kronhjortflokkene etter næring. Plaget av stikkende insekter trekker hjortene opp i fjellene for å slippe dem, men der risikerer de i stedet å bli bytte for sjeldne villkatter.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: Alpene er i endring, ikke gjennom dramatiske omveltninger, men sakte og gradvis. Stigende temperaturer og flere tiår med menneskelig påvirkning forandrer fjellområdet, som lenge har vært preget av stabile forhold. Steinbukker, murmeldyr og fjellryper møter ulike utfordringer i høyfjellet, men endringene åpner også for nye muligheter. Hvordan vil de ulike artene tilpasse seg? Nede i dalene truer endrede elveløp fuglearter som hekker på åpne grusbanker. Opplev en sårbar verden i stadig forandring.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Høsten forvandler Karpatenes fjellsider til et bølgende teppe av bronse, ravgult og gull. Skogene fylles av kronhjortenes mektige brøl, som varsler kampen om retten til å samle en flokk med hinder. Oppgjørene er brutale, og de svekkede taperne blir et lett bytte for ulveflokker på jakt etter et enkelt måltid. For bjørnene gjelder det å fråtse i bær og nøtter for å legge på seg før vinterdvalen. Til tross for sin enorme størrelse klatrer de opp bøke- og furustammer for å nå de saftigste nøttene i trekronene. De går også inn på menneskenes åkere for å forsyne seg av mais. De gjør nesten hva som helst for å stille sulten. Alle disse storslåtte dyrenes overlevelse avhenger av de gamle skogene. De gamle trærne binder skadelig karbon fra atmosfæren og bidrar til å regulere jordas klima, en livsviktig funksjon for alt liv.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Alpebukker springer ned fra de bratte klippene, himmelen fylles av millioner av fugler under det imponerende trekket, og midt på vinteren leter den sjeldne gaupa etter en make.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: Alpene er i endring, ikke gjennom dramatiske omveltninger, men sakte og gradvis. programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: Tysklands Mittelgebirge fascinerer med eldgamle skoger og urørt natur. Gjennom høstskogen runger kronhjortens kraftige brøl i tåken. Brunsten er i gang. I Sächsische Schweiz holder vandrefalker og svartstork til blant dramatiske klippeformasjoner. Den sky gaupa streifer gjennom skogene, mens et nytt og villere skoglandskap vokser fram i Harz i takt med et klima i endring.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Vest i Middelhavet ligger Portugal, med et mangfold av økosystemer som huser et imponerende rikt dyreliv. Mange av artene finnes bare i denne delen av verden og er tett knyttet sammen i et økosystem som gir dyrene grunnlag for å overleve i et til tider krevende landskap. En ildsalamander, som kan bli opptil 50 år gammel, nyter sitt første måltid etter å ha tilbrakt den tørre sommeren i dvale under jorden. Iberiagaupa, en av verdens sjeldneste villkatter, jakter på favorittbyttet sitt, kanin. Kongeørn og rev, som vanligvis er rivaler, tolererer hverandre lenge nok til å dele et bytte. Samtidig forbereder unge pyreneersteinbukker seg på voksenlivet ved å bryne hornene mot hverandre i en imponerende styrkeprøve.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Langs Portugals kyst er livet både vakkert og brutalt for de unike artene som lever der, fra mikroskopisk planteplankton til enorme spermhvaler. Vinkekrabbene kjemper om retten til å pare seg i kystlagunene. Sepiablekksprutenen, en mester i kamuflasje, sniker seg inn på intetanende byttedyr. Storker bygger reir på de bratte klippene langs Atlanterhavskysten og vokter ungene sine mot rovdyr.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Klinikken står overfor nok en travel uke når de får inn katter med forstoppelser, hester med mye gass i magen og et overraskende frieri. Dr. Pol trimmer de forvokste hornene til en geit og gir den sjansen til å leve mange gode år til. Og Charles, som er på ferie i England, overrasker kjæresten sin Beth med et frieri! Ser ut til at Pol-staben får nok en sak å ta seg av, nemlig bryllupsplanlegging!

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Mens høsten melder sin ankomst i Michigan og bladene skifter farger, møter staben på Pol Veterinary Services på den samme gamle travle hverdagen! Dr. Pol tar seg av et dramatisk tilfelle med et tre dager gammelt babyreinsdyr, og dr. Emily hjelper en bulldog med kvelningsanfall. Og for dr. Brenda kommer julen tidlig i år når hun får et oppdrag med en flokk julenisser og reinsdyrene deres.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Mysterious North: Land of Mountain Forests
programme.desc: Fra pangoliner, asiatiske palmesivetter og Delacours langurer til cat ba-langurer og de nylig oppdagede vitenamesiske krokodilleøglene. Vi ser på det utrolige utvalget av unike dyr som trives i de ekstreme forholdene som finnes i de skogkledde fjellene i Vietnam.

programme.desc: Kambodsja er et mystisk land formet av Mekongelva. Vannet dominerer landet og har skapt noen av jordas mest unike økosystemer.
